history.title: Brick Bounce
history.summary: Brick Bounce - minimal breakout clone with paddle, ball, bricks, lives, win/lose states

feedback.gripe: missing lives UI, unclear red line on game over, frame ghosting
feedback.wish: something a bit bigger would be nice, maybe some animations, sprites, sound, etc

history.title: Nebula Drift
history.summary: Nebula Drift - top-down arena survival shooter with momentum thrust and dash, 4 enemy types incl. a Warden boss every 5th wave, energy-orb charged screen-clearing pulse, combo multiplier, power-up drops (repair/rapid/charge), particle VFX, screen shake, procedural animated sprites, and dependency-free synth audio

feedback.replayability: 7-8, yes - replayed to wave 21 before boredom set in
feedback.gripe: Only the fast small yellow enemies (Darters) and the boss were a real threat, and the boss could be trivially avoided by dashing. Dash should grant i-frames and should not collide with enemies you dash through/past. Some sounds felt off - boss hit sounds were too light. Biggest structural gripe: by wave 21 there was nothing new and no progression; difficulty needed to ramp faster and the game needed a roguelite-style upgrade system to stay enjoyable long term.
feedback.wish: Dash i-frames + phase-through, punchier/harder-hitting boss hit audio, faster difficulty ramp, roguelite progression/upgrades for long-term replay

history.title: Lanternfall
history.summary: Lanternfall - turn-based tactics roguelite on procedurally generated floating isometric islands: 3-hero squad vs 6 enemy types and the Hollow King, light/shroud system with per-pixel dynamic lighting, shoves into the void, tactical AI, 7-island run with upgrade drafts and route choice, 5 biomes, adaptive synth score, tutorial, undo, persistent save

feedback.overall: 7/10 - very fun, will replay and share with friends; not my normal type of game
feedback.fun: 7/10 overall; figuring out the lantern lighting mechanic was cool
feedback.replayability: will be playing it again and sharing with friends; reached island 3
feedback.controls: movement felt tricky - easy to get stuck in one place
feedback.gripe: movement tricky, easy to get stuck in one place
feedback.liked: lantern/lighting mechanic, having music, art style

history.title: Night Signal
history.summary: Night Signal - a 14-night radio station management game about matching broadcasts to neighborhood needs, routing power across relay networks, and balancing audience with trust

not_applicable.multiple-enemy-or-piece-types: There are no enemies or battle pieces; broadcast programs and districts are not combat units.
not_applicable.boss-or-climax: There is a campaign finale but no distinct boss/climax encounter beyond the last broadcast.
not_applicable.pickups-or-powerups: Funds and upgrades are part of the station economy, not acquired drops or temporary pickups.
not_applicable.particles-vfx: The current renderer uses static signal lines and does not render particles.
not_applicable.screen-shake-juice: The current renderer does not animate camera shake or impact effects.
not_applicable.animated-sprites: The districts and skyline are static pixel illustrations without animated characters.
not_applicable.procedural-level-generation: The city map uses fixed district locations; only district needs are seeded.
not_applicable.tactical-ai-opponent: No combat encounters, movable pieces, destructible map props or pickup drops exist in this broadcast management game.
not_applicable.persistent-save-file: Scores and upgrades are kept for a campaign only; there is no between-session save.
not_applicable.route-choice: The campaign follows a fixed 14-night sequence without branching routes.
not_applicable.multiple-biomes: All districts belong to one city and share its blackout conditions.
not_applicable.dynamic-lighting: The broadcast network uses signal lines and has no light simulation.
not_applicable.tutorial-onboarding: The title screen lists controls, but no guided in-game tutorial or help screen is included.
not_applicable.undo-move: A committed broadcast is the current night and cannot be undone.
not_applicable.threat-preview: The city calendar has periodic outages but no tactical enemies whose next actions need previewing.
not_applicable.autopilot-playtest: The selftest directly drives the rules but does not run a general campaign-playing bot.
not_applicable.in-run-upgrade-draft: There is a direct station-upgrade purchase, not a pick-one-of-N draft.

history.title: Cragswing
history.summary: Cragswing - real-time rope-swinging platformer roguelite: five procedurally generated ascents plus the Stormheart boss, momentum that smashes glass and armour, hold-to-rewind time, 15 boons, route choice, Workshop perks, Heat levels, medals, adaptive music and a headless autopilot

not_applicable.broadcast-programming: Night Signal's radio scheduling has no analogue in a real-time platformer.
not_applicable.power-grid-allocation: There is no station or power budget to route; resources here are hearts, Echo and speed.
not_applicable.community-trust-network: No neighbourhood or trust system; progress is spatial and per-ascent.
